requested_change: Make wonder dominate fear while preserving mystery, the founding crime, and the partial-record ending. Keep the intimate cost but let it sharpen wonder rather than replace it.

changes.note: Working architecture proposal only. Accepted Identity, Structure, Book, relations and prose remain unchanged. Any real downstream impact needs the existing source-backed impact/revision workflows.

changed_components.title: Governing summary
changed_components.before: A literary mystery in which every accurate map purchases knowledge with an intimate memory, forcing a surveyor to decide whether her city should remember a massacre or keep the lie that holds it together. Wonder at the coast's strangeness becomes dread as the cost turns personal, then an earned, conditional hope about chosen remembrance.
changed_components.after: A literary mystery in which every accurate map purchases knowledge with an intimate memory, but wonder at the coast and at the act of discovery remains the governing experience. The surveyor must choose what her city remembers; fear and grief shadow wonder without displacing it, and the ending offers a partial, chosen hope rather than a clean restoration.

changed_components.title: Dread progression
changed_components.before: As the cost becomes personal, the reader's desire for the truth becomes entangled with fear of what it will erase.
changed_components.after: Fear shadows wonder, sharpening attention without taking over the experience.

changed_components.title: Intimate horror
changed_components.before: The horror is the quiet loss of a shared reference, a name, or a face rather than visible violence.
changed_components.after: Loss appears as a shadow on wonder rather than as a spectacular threat.

changed_components.title: Wonder promise
changed_components.before: The coast and the maps are presented as strange and beautiful, inviting the reader to want the survey to succeed.
changed_components.after: Wonder governs the story promise and survives every discovered cost.

changed_components.title: Archive revelation
changed_components.before: Reveal the founding crime and the Guild's complicity. | Reader experience: Moral dread and anger; the truth is larger than the surveyor. | Transition: A perfect map becomes possible, and with it a city-wide erasure.
changed_components.after: Expand wonder into historical awe while revealing complicity. | Reader experience: Wonder at the archive scale, crossed by moral anger. | Transition: A perfect map becomes possible, and with it a city-wide erasure.

changed_components.title: Choice of maps
changed_components.before: Resolve the choice through a partial, chosen remembrance. | Reader experience: Earned, conditional hope through grief. | Transition: The city keeps a record that is honest about what it cannot restore.
changed_components.after: Resolve through a wonder that accepts loss. | Reader experience: Wonder survives grief; hope is chosen and partial. | Transition: The city keeps a record that is honest about what it cannot restore.

changed_components.title: First erasure
changed_components.before: Turn wonder into dread by making the cost personal. | Reader experience: Dread becomes personal. | Transition: The missing memory points to the founding archive.
changed_components.after: Deepen wonder by showing that knowledge has a price. | Reader experience: Wonder persists through the first cost; fear is a shadow, not the center. | Transition: The missing memory points to the founding archive.

changed_components.title: Strange coast
changed_components.before: Establish wonder and the map's promise. | Reader experience: Wonder and curiosity; the reader wants the survey to succeed. | Transition: A first memory is found missing.
changed_components.after: Establish wonder as the story governing promise. | Reader experience: Wonder dominates; curiosity is the governing pleasure. | Transition: A first memory is found missing.

changed_components.after: Role: governing; engine: Each answer changes what the surveyor must conceal or reveal, and every archive record is also an occasion for wonder at how the city was made.; structure: Wonder, question, partial answer, intimate cost, deeper wonder, final choice.
